stories: Sign-in keyboard focus stays visible at 100%.
Sign-in keyboard focus stays visible at 200%.
Sign-in keyboard focus stays visible at 400%.
The first shortcut, signup, return to sign-in and password recovery work at 400% with the return path intact.
At 400%, the short-screen menu closes with Escape and returns visible focus to its trigger.
At 400%, the shortcut preserves search, a submitted search and Back focus the results, and the preview preserves the sign-in return path.
At 400%, the Clips shortcut and Reel link lead to a transcript that opens from the keyboard.

compiledReelStories: The built Clips page keeps both formats and opens a keyboard-accessible Reel anchor with source, license and Circle links.
A Reel link opens its own credited page and preview title. Clipboard and share-sheet fixtures receive only that public URL and title before any media loads.
Keyboard Load keeps focus on the control, then Tab reaches the paused player. The exact media and timed text load without account cookies or referrer.
The actual derivative plays through at normal speed with silent portrait video and four captions, including all four editorial beats.
Keyboard Unload retires the video, keeps focus on Load and leaves the transcript and source links usable.
The Reel brings its question to the public directory with the online and hybrid filter selected.
Unknown and non-Reel catalog IDs return 404 on the public Reel route.
Keyboard Cancel keeps focus on Load, retires a held media request and permits a fresh load.
compiledSalonStories: The public API discards supplied authority and returns seven listing fields. Hidden and malformed targets are refused.
The homepage keyboard shortcut reaches online and hybrid search. Philemon and each Reel reach the same directory. Search keeps the Reel question out of the API request.
A guest sees the public preview at 320px with no account or meeting request. Sign-in and signup retain the Circle from the preview and navigation.
The built password sign-in verifies synthetic identity and returns to the same Circle and online directory.
A verified nonmember reviews the norms and confirms membership before the private meeting control appears.
The verified Circle opens Quest Browser with the same Reel question and a sign-in link back to it.
A current member opens the archive, edits the Reel question and public link, reviews the exact text, and saves one message only after confirmation.
The current member opens the fresh link in the same tab without app credentials or a referrer. Back needs a new access check.
Losing focus during a held meeting check aborts the read and retires the opening action.
A member removed after loading Circle details cannot open the cached meeting. The current nonmember view is shown.
The reviewed RSVP is stored in SQL. Leaving removes it and takes the meeting control out of the view.
Host completion removes the private URL from the API and blocks cached meeting actions while preserving discussion.
A direct hidden Circle link discloses no listing, even after sign-in.
A duplicate or unreviewed Reel reference never selects a question or triggers a Circle request.
scope: Compiled web build in local Chromium. Synthetic account and database for Circle journeys. Manual screen-reader, contrast review items, real-device testing and hosted release remain pending.
